headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.filteredMargin_at_retained
headlines.statement:
∀ (xs : List ℕ) (k : Fin (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveMargins xs).length),
  Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.filteredMargin xs k =
    Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.listMargin xs ↑((Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveIndexEquiv xs) k)

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.zeroMarginListEquiv_extend_entry
headlines.statement:
∀ (xs ys : List ℕ)
  (X :
    OAI.ContingencyTables.Table (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.filteredMargin xs)
      (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.filteredMargin ys))
  (i : Fin xs.length) (j : Fin ys.length),
  ↑((Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.zeroMarginListEquiv xs ys).symm X) i j =
    if hi : 0 < Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.listMargin xs i then
      if hj : 0 < Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.listMargin ys j then
        ↑X ((Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveIndexEquiv xs).symm ⟨i, hi⟩)
          ((Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveIndexEquiv ys).symm ⟨j, hj⟩)
      else 0
    else 0

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.restoreZeroMarginListsLaw_uniform_variation
headlines.statement:
∀ (xs ys : List ℕ)
  (htotal : ∑ i, Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.listMargin xs i = ∑ j, Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.listMargin ys j)
  (q :
    OAI.ContingencyTables.ResidualMixture.RationalLaw
      (OAI.ContingencyTables.Table (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.filteredMargin xs)
        (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.filteredMargin ys))),
  OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.variation (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.restoreZeroMarginListsLaw xs ys q)
      OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw =
    OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.variation q OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw
